checks.title: The wiki path points at the wiki root
checks.explain: Every wiki write lands under the resolved wiki directory. A path one level too high (the vault instead of its wiki folder) or one level too deep sends pages to the wrong place, so this check runs first.

checks.title: The global config exists and parses
checks.explain: The global config in the config directory holds the defaults every project inherits, such as the wiki path. It is optional, but a broken one stops every skill that reads config.

checks.title: This machine is classified
checks.explain: Skills write the live vault only on a workstation; elsewhere they queue the change. The classification comes from the host and can be forced with an environment variable.

checks.title: The command-line tools the configured platform needs are installed
checks.explain: Tracker and VCS steps run through their CLIs. A missing one fails the first skill that needs it.

checks.title: The working directory is a git repository
checks.explain: Project config, branches and pull requests hang off a repository. A directory without one needs a project set up first.

checks.title: The project config has a location
checks.explain: A project's config lives either in the user config directory (the default) or inside the repository. The location decides who sees it and whether it travels with the repo.

checks.title: The tracker and VCS are recorded for this project
checks.explain: Every issue skill reads the tracker and VCS from the platform config. Without them no issue can be read, started or closed.

checks.title: The workflow phases are bound to tracker statuses
checks.explain: The workflow moves an issue by its phase. A tracker whose statuses differ from the adapter default needs an explicit binding.

checks.title: The tracker board has the statuses the binding names
checks.explain: A binding can only point at statuses that exist on the board. Checking that needs the tracker, so the board skill does it.
